# AuthorKit Resources

> Free tools and guides for authors publishing on Amazon KDP. No sign-up, no email. Every number shows where it comes from and when it was checked.

## Resources

- [KDP cover calculator](https://resources.authorkit.pro/cover-calculator/): Full cover, spine and interior margins, in inches and mm, drawn to scale.
- [Novel word count by genre](https://resources.authorkit.pro/novel-word-count/): Typical lengths for fiction categories and publisher lines, each from a named source.
- [KDP royalty calculator](https://resources.authorkit.pro/kdp-royalty-calculator/): Amazon.com paperback royalty per sale, and net royalty in rupees after US withholding for an Indian author.
- [Publishing on KDP from India](https://resources.authorkit.pro/kdp-from-india/): Where KDP sells, how the tax interview and payments work, and what to ask a Chartered Accountant. Draft.
- [ISBN in India](https://resources.authorkit.pro/isbn-india/): How to apply to RRRNA for a free ISBN, KDP's free ISBN vs your own, and one ISBN per format.
- [Copyright page generator](https://resources.authorkit.pro/copyright-page-generator/): Copyright page text for your book, with the reason for each line and its source.
- [KDP paperback preflight checklist](https://resources.authorkit.pro/kdp-preflight-checklist/): What KDP rejects in a paperback interior PDF, as a tick list with the margins for your page count.
- [Book design templates](https://resources.authorkit.pro/book-design-templates/): Font pairings for book interiors by type and genre. Paste a page of your manuscript and see it set on a KDP trim.
- [Book description formatter](https://resources.authorkit.pro/book-description-formatter/): Turn a plain-text book description into the HTML KDP accepts, with a preview and a count against the 4000-character limit.
- [Book mockups](https://resources.authorkit.pro/book-mockups/): Which mockup to make for A+ Content, BookBub and Facebook ads, social posts, a box set or an open book, at what size, and nine tools compared.
